ops.title: Phase 5 gate verdict: metal relay flip VERIFIED 2026-07-14
ops.body:
Commits 47125e12 + 9b88e0ae. rapid-mlx/mlx-audio on metal are now socat1 relays to yasyf-home (bind TSIP, connect-timeout=10, max-children=64, -t 600; HOSTIP via wait_tailscale_ip yasyf-home). Verified: hermes->metal:8000/8765 = 200 (86/156 ms), cold wake+infer 6.4 s end-to-end, metal:22 blocked (ACL default-deny intact), relays survive cold boot; metal freed ~20 GB.

Two landmines for future deploys: (1) the macOS app firewall keys on the RESOLVED executable — nix socat's bin/socat is a symlink to bin/socat1 and --add of the symlink registers nothing (inbound silently swallowed: handshake completes in the listen backlog, accept() never fires); metal.nix now single-sources socatBin = socat1 for exec + both ALF loops. (2) metal's repo-share virtiofs cache pins recently-guest-read files through host-side edits: redeploy-after-edit either fails loud (truncated eval) or SILENTLY deploys the coherent pre-edit tree; purge/TTL don't clear it — reboot the guest before redeploying, and check for "reloading service" lines + the daemon's new exec in ps.

Phase 6 (teardown + shrink to 16 GB/2 vCPU) unblocked; switch-before-resize ordering chosen.
